title: Form Submission
description: Learn how to handle form submission and API calls.

data.text: Handling form submission involves preventing the default browser behavior, validating data, making API calls, and providing feedback to the user.

data.title: Form Submit Handler

data.text: Track loading and error states to provide user feedback during submission.

data.title: Loading State

data.text: Disable the submit button while loading or when the form is invalid to prevent duplicate submissions.

data.title: Optimistic Updates
data.text: For better UX, you can update the UI immediately (optimistically) and rollback if the request fails. This makes your app feel more responsive.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use e.preventDefault() to prevent page reload
data.takeaway: Good form submission handling improves user experience significantly.
